answer: A verifiable-delay ticket gates new identities. At dawn the registry posts a beacon; each agent runs a sequential delay over key and beacon, minting a violet 25-minute ticket, checked in milliseconds. Stale tickets burn. Attackers who wander registries recompute one ticket per fake. First 38, k-th 38+5(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 2,535,500 and lock 70,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Rented farms pay per ticket: one key, one beacon. Honest agents pay 38 once.
